method: Executed on the unchanged 1.7.10 classes (tools/probes/Entnbt96Probe.java): a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe.make) loaded with Entity.readFromNBT or given effects with addPotionEffect, ticked with EntityLivingBase.onEntityUpdate (sv.C) and written with Entity.writeToNBT. players: [name, stage, live fields, kept keys of the written compound]; potions: the Attributes list after applying each potion at amplifier 0 and 2. A sleeping load runs on a WorldServer double with one bed block; EntityPlayer.onUpdate (the awake SleepTimer count) is bytecode-read only.
